class_definitions.A: Historical data with reliable point-in-time availability evidence.
class_definitions.B: Useful historical data whose point-in-time availability cannot be proved.
class_definitions.C: Prospective data Robin can capture with complete receipts after the stated legal/access gates.
class_definitions.D: Redundant, prohibited, legally doubtful, technically unavailable or disproportionate data.

classification_rule: Exactly one source_class is assigned to every logical product. Separate current and historical products are separate candidates when their temporal guarantees differ. Class D is a fail-closed hard veto whenever commercial retention/reuse rights are unclear, conditional on an unexecuted custom contract, restricted or prohibited; that legal veto takes precedence over an otherwise A/B/C-shaped temporal profile.
